steps: 0DTE (zero days to expiration) refers to options contracts that expire at the end of the current trading day. These are also called same day expiring or ultra short-dated options. This type of trading has existed since listed options were introduced in 1973, though it has seen increased popularity in recent years as more weekly expiries have been added for many listed options.
